result.summary: Modular-Monolith architecture with 4 services on None (Local Deployment)

output.overview: The system is designed to automate the smoke testing of the analyst_report_v2 artifact generation, ensuring reliability and error-free execution. It includes components for triggering, validating, and logging the artifact generation process, with a focus on local deployment using Docker-compatible services.

services.name: Artifact Generation Service
services.responsibility: Triggers and manages the generation of the analyst_report_v2 artifact.

services.name: Validation Service
services.responsibility: Validates the completion and integrity of the generated artifact.

services.name: Logging Service
services.responsibility: Logs the artifact generation process and any errors encountered.

services.name: Notification Service
services.responsibility: Sends notifications to stakeholders upon test completion.

security.encryption: TLS for data in transit, AES-256 for data at rest

auto_scaling_rules: Scale out when CPU usage exceeds 70% for 5 minutes
Scale in when CPU usage drops below 30% for 10 minutes
scalability.caching_strategy: Use Redis for caching frequently accessed data

data_flow.description: User initiates the artifact generation process via CLI or API call.
Artifact Generation Service sends a request to validate the generated artifact.
Validation Service logs the result of the artifact validation process.
Logging Service triggers a notification to stakeholders with the test results.

latency_optimizations: Use Redis for caching to reduce database load
Optimize artifact generation code for faster execution
Implement asynchronous processing for non-critical tasks
Use HTTP/2 for faster API communication

trade_offs.rationale: Simplifies local deployment and reduces overhead compared to microservices.
Avoids cloud costs and simplifies development environment setup.
Provides non-blocking I/O and is well-suited for handling concurrent requests.
